ABOUT US

Small Team.
Big Execution.

Evenflow Studio is a product development studio based in Poznań, Poland. We help founders turn ideas into working products without unnecessary complexity. We combine product thinking, design and development to build launch-ready MVPs in just 3 weeks.

OUR PROCESS

From Idea to MVP in 21 Days.

A clear and focused process to turn your idea into a real product.

1
WEEK 1

Discover and Design

  • Understand your business idea
  • Define MVP scope and key features
  • Create user flows and UI/UX direction
  • Agree on milestones
2
WEEK 2

Build

  • Develop core product
  • Implement essential features
  • Share progress and collect feedback
3
WEEK 3

Test and Launch

  • Test key user journeys
  • Fix critical issues
  • Deploy the agreed scope
  • Provide launch handover and next steps
